subject: New to Java, really need help!

messages.author: 0a4078d0dc563512
messages.subject: New to Java, really need help!
parts:
Hi guys,

I am a complete stranger to java and I have been trying the simple example in the guide and have failed. http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/introduction.html#prerequisites
I really really need some help! Thanks in advance!

So my questions are:

1. I finally found out that I need the renjin-script-engine library instead of the renjin-studio library. But seems like renjin-script-engine cannot be found anymore, can anybody tell me where to find it? Here is the code but I have been adding the renin-studio library, so I guess that is why it failed.

import javax.script.*;

//... add additional imports here ...


public class TryRenjin {

     public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {

         // create a script engine manager:

         ScriptEngineManager manager = new ScriptEngineManager();

         // create a Renjin engine:

         ScriptEngine engine = manager.getEngineByName("Renjin");

         // check if the engine has loaded correctly:

         if(engine == null) {

             throw new RuntimeException("Renjin Script Engine not found on the classpath.");

         }

     }   

}


2. What can renjin-studio do? Seems like when I wrote the basic R code in the studio it worked. I will also need to use some R packages such as randomForest, so I wonder can they be used in the renjin-studio thing? Do I have to learn java and maven to use the R packages?


The only reason I am learning this Renjin thing is that I have a very large data set to deal with and when I used R directly it was so slow and sometimes it would even crush. Will this Renjin thing actually help in solving this problem?  


Can somebody help me out?

Thanks soooooooo much!


Mary

messages.subject: Re: New to Java, really need help!
parts:
Dear Mary,

indeed the link that's in our documentation has changed and I will fix this today. In the mean time, you can find the renjin-script-engine jars here: http://nexus.bedatadriven.com/content/groups/public/org/renjin/renjin-script-engine/0.7.0-RC8-SNAPSHOT/ This a folder with snapshots (i.e. not releases) so find the one with the most recent date at the bottom of this page.

Regards,

Maarten-Jan

messages.subject: New to Java, really need help!
parts:
Mary,

May I suggest that you try SciCom? If you don't know anything about java this might make your life easier.

You'll need to install JRUBY (really easy) and then install Scicom. I can help you with that if you need.

Would love to have some feedback on performance.

Good luck!
